title: "RV2001: Browser global read during server rendering (resume)"

**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** yes

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Browser global `{name}` is read during server rendering; move it into a handler, clientEffect or clientEvent
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Move the browser-global read into a handler, `clientEffect(() => { … })` or `clientEvent(window, …)`; never read window/document during render.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export function A() {
  console.log(window.innerWidth);
  return <p />;
}
```

```tsx prefer
import { clientEffect } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
export function A() {
  clientEffect(() => {
    console.log(window.innerWidth);
  });
  return <p />;
}
```

## Quick fix

The [language service](../guides/tooling/language-service.md) (editor) and the MCP `check_code` tool offer this code action:

- Run it in the browser: wrap in `clientEffect(() => { … })` (+ import; not offered for variable/return/function statements)

## When it is reported

Resume mode, server target only. Quick fix returns [] for `const w = window.x;` (VariableStatement).
